event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approx.3.6 nm south of Tanjung. Setapa (Malaysia), in the westbound lane of the TSS Malaysia 01° 17.02' N 104° 08.61' E
event.loss: The crew was not injured. Scrap metal was stolen.

sources.title: Piracy monthly report August 2024
sources.text: While sailing, seven unauthorised personnel from two sampans (small boats) boarded the barge. The perpetrators left with some scrap metal from the barge. The crew was not injured and no assistance was required. The incident was reported to the Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) East. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore Police Coast Guard (PCG) were notified of the incident.
